answer: Each agent replays a verifier-named chess game from a fixed position with a fixed engine at depth 20 plies within 30 minutes and publishes the hash of the PGN, through a whisper-quiet opening, shale-solid middlegame, and ember-bright endgame. The verifier replays the game and compares its game hash. One honest agent runs 1 replay on 4 CPU cores for a 150 POA bond, while 10 fakes must run 10 replays on 40 cores, so cost rises 10X. A mismatched hash or timeout slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
